description: This file defines the class tlRole, which models user roles within the TestLink system, including properties and methods for managing roles, their rights, database interactions, and user associations.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents a user role in TestLink, with capabilities to read, write, delete, and manage rights and associated users.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tlRole object, optionally loading data by database ID.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets the role's description, rights, name, and ID based on provided options.

methods.name: copyFromCache
methods.description: Copies the properties of another tlRole object into this one.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Loads role data from the database with specified options.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Saves the role's data to the database, inserting or updating as necessary.

methods.name: checkDetails
methods.description: Validates the role's details before database operations.

methods.name: doesRoleExist
methods.description: Checks if a role with the given name exists in the database, excluding a specific ID.

methods.name: checkRoleName
methods.description: Validates the role's name length.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display-friendly name for the role, translating if necessary.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the role from the database and updates related user roles.

methods.name: replaceUserRolesWith
methods.description: Replaces all user role assignments from this role to another specified role.

methods.name: getUsersWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Retrieves all users assigned to this global role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Fetches user IDs of users with this role globally.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Fetches user IDs of users with this role in test projects.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Fetches user IDs of users with this role in test plans.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Retrieves user objects with this role in test projects.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Retrieves user objects with this role in test plans.

methods.name: getAllUsersWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves all users associated with this role, across global, test plan, and test project roles.

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specified right.

methods.name: deleteRightsFromDB
methods.description: Deletes all rights associated with this role in the database.

methods.name: addRightsToDB
methods.description: Adds rights to this role in the database.

methods.name: readRights
methods.description: Loads rights associated with this role from the database.

methods.name: buildRightsArray
methods.description: Constructs an array of tlRight objects from database info.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a role by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Static method to retrieve all roles, with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Static method placeholder (not implemented) to retrieve roles by multiple IDs.

methods.name: getRoleColourCfg
methods.description: Returns a map of role descriptions to configured colors.
